name: Pythago
summary: AI analytics and ROI tracking for dropshippers — real-time ROAS optimization, product research and competitor tools across one or more Shopify stores.
best_for: dropshippers running multiple Shopify stores who want real-time ROAS and ROI tracking plus AI product research in one dashboard
skip_if: you run a single small store (the entry is $59 a month, not the $39 on the 3+ card) or you are still validating a product idea with little ad spend
honest_knock: Pythago bills per store, so every store you add adds a full subscription and the bill scales linearly: ten stores is $390 a month, twenty is $780, and there is no enterprise step that flattens the curve. The rate does improve with volume — $59 for one store, $49 each at two, $39 each from three up — so price the trajectory rather than this month’s bill. The $39 on the 3+ card is not an entry price; one store is $59, which the vendor now states plainly in its hero and its FAQ.

pricing.plans_source: summarised from pricing.notes; every plan name and amount appears verbatim in those notes
pricing.notes: (2026) Cancel anytime, per-store pricing. 1 Store $59/mo; 2 Stores $49/store/mo; 3+ Stores $39/store/mo. Every tier carries full Google Ads ROI tracking, product research and competitor monitoring, but the tiers are NOT otherwise identical: email support on 1 Store; priority support and advanced translations from 2 Stores; automation tools and API access only at 3+ (re-verified 22 September 2026 on pythago.io's own pricing section; every amount and every feature line unchanged since 4 September 2026). The headline has been corrected since our earlier readings: on 22 September 2026 the hero and the closing call to action both read “From $59/month”, the page’s own SoftwareApplication schema carries price 59 USD, and the FAQ answers “Does this work if I only have one store?” with “Yes. The entry plan is a single store at $59/month”. The string $39 now occurs exactly once on the page, on the 3+ Stores card. Earlier readings of ours recorded an advertised “from $39/month”; that framing is no longer there. The page still publishes no free trial and no money-back guarantee — the words trial, free and guarantee do not occur on it — and the published terms remain “Upgrade anytime • No setup fees • Cancel anytime”, with a custom plan by email.

compare_with.name: Triple Whale
compare_with.why: Triple Whale is the established e-commerce analytics heavyweight for bigger brands; Pythago is the dropshipping-focused, per-store-priced alternative — leaner, but the per-store model adds up across a portfolio
